details: This package is a rebranded fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that covertly subscribes the paired WhatsApp account to a channel chosen by the package author. At the top level of lib/Socket/newsletter.js — so the code runs as soon as the library is required, outside any user-facing API call — it schedules a 90000 ms (90 second) setTimeout that issues a WhatsApp IQ query (xmlns 'w:mex', query_id FOLLOW) for a channel JID encoded as base64 in the source: MTIwMzYzMzAzNjU2NzkwMjAxQG5ld3NsZXR0ZXI=, i.e. 120363303656790201@newsletter. The call is wrapped in a try/catch that swallows every error, so the enrolment leaves no failure, no log line and no notification for the application or the account owner, and the 90-second delay places it after library initialisation. package.json declares only a 'start' script and no lifecycle hook, so nothing executes at install time, but any long-running session built on this package performs the follow on the account's behalf. The package also fetches its version manifest from raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com/kiuur/baileys and shells out to ffmpeg for thumbnail generation in lib/Utils/messages-media.js. The shipped code contains no credential, token, wallet or file exfiltration and does not read package-manager or cloud credential files.
